mechanism_name: FUNDJUMP — funding-announcement jump (carry-cost shock) event book
mechanism_story: WHO IS FORCED / SLOW TO REACT: every leveraged holder of the USD-M perp pays or receives the announced funding at each settlement; a positive JUMP in the announced rate is a discrete, public repricing of carry cost. The forced actor is the under-margined directional long whose 8h carry cost just stepped above his continuation threshold: he does not exit instantly — margin top-ups, gradual size-downs and stop revisions leak over the following hours (slow to react). The second flow is arbitrage supply: the jump makes the short-perp/long-spot basis trade newly profitable, and basis-trade capital mechanically SELLS the perp after the announcement to harvest the elevated carry — a scheduled, directional, capacity-constrained flow that arrives only after the boundary. WHY THE EFFECT EXISTS: the funding rate is computed from the premium index (perp-over-spot order-flow pressure), so a jump simultaneously reveals crowded one-sided leverage AND pays arbitrageurs to lean against it; because the announcement is public, discrete and timestamped, the forced response concentrates in the following interval instead of diffusing. OBSERVABLE: the announced rate change d_i = f_i - f_{i-1} at settlement k_i from keyless fapi /fapi/v1/fundingRate history, gated to the trailing-90d top decile of |d|; the book is SHORT after up-jumps, LONG after down-jumps for one funding interval. WHEN IT MUST FAIL: when jumps are noise around a pegged rate (no carry repricing, no farmer response), when basis-trade capacity is already saturated so the supply response is absent, or when the announcement is pre-impounded (Binance pre-displays the payable rate during the prior interval, letting traders front-run the boundary) — then post-announcement drift vanishes and tier-2.0 round trips dominate. NOVELTY TRIPLE vs forbidden funding-carry ancestry: information source is the ANNOUNCED CHANGE (event flow at a timestamped settlement) not the funding LEVEL (stock); causal story is forced carry-cost deleveraging + farmer supply response, not carry collection; control class is a randomized-event-time sham, not an exposure-form control. D2 measures pooled rho on the exposure series below; if it exceeds 0.20 vs funding carry/divergence/crowding-MR the family is vetoed, not rescued.
universe: BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT (published panel symbols; keyless fapi fundingRate history exists for both, 8h settlements)
clock: H1 (published UTC-H1 panel buckets; decision at bucket close t uses only rows with close_ts <= t; fills at next-bucket VWAP)
warmup: Rolling trailing 90-day window of settlement changes (~270 settlements per symbol = 2,160 H1 decisions of consumed lookback), seeded from pre-S0 keyless fundingRate history 2025-05-24..2025-08-21 so that the whole S0 window 2025-08-22..2026-08-21 is tradeable across the 3 chronological folds; the window rolls forward and the |d| P90 threshold is recomputed from past-only settlements at every event evaluation.
features_and_lags: Inputs (authorized keyless endpoint, no signup/key): fapi public REST GET /fapi/v1/fundingRate?symbol={s} — fields fundingTime (ms, settlement instant k_i) and fundingRate (f_i, the rate applied AT that settlement). Derived: d_i = f_i - f_{i-1}; E_i = 1 if |d_i| >= trailing-90d P90 of |d_j| over settlements with k_j <= k_i, else 0. Panel columns consumed (section 2 names): vwap (entry and exit fills), symbol (join key), first_ts_ms / last_ts_ms (bucket alignment). AVAILABILITY LAW: the pair (k_i, f_i) is admissible to a decision at bucket close T iff k_i <= T — conservative, since Binance may pre-display the payable rate during the prior interval and we never use it before its own settlement; threshold quantiles use strictly past settlements (k_j <= k_i); NO same-bucket close peeking (a signal observed at close t fills at the VWAP of bucket t+1); funding accrues to the NEXT settlement boundary after announcement, which is exactly the holding window — the book never credits a same-instant funding PnL.
entry_exit_fills: Entry: at the first H1 bucket close T >= k_i with E_i = 1, fill at the VWAP of bucket (T, T+1h] (next-bucket VWAP). Exit: fill at the VWAP of the first H1 bucket whose close >= k_{i+1} (the next settlement boundary, nominally k_i + 8h). One position per symbol; events firing while a position is open are ignored (no pyramiding, no flip). Force-flat: any open position is closed at the last bucket VWAP before the +/-1-day purge zone around each internal fold boundary; no fills and no carries inside purge zones; no position ever touches S1.
costs: Taker charged EXACTLY ONCE PER FILL (L-V14-0 acknowledged): fee 5.0 bps baseline x tier multiplier (x1.0 / x1.5 / x2.0) with slip floors 1 / 1 / 2 ticks; TIER 2.0 IS THE PRIMARY BOOK — all expectancies, gates (G1-G12) and pre-registered kills below are evaluated at tier 2.0; stress multipliers apply to booked PnL.
anchor: FUNDJUMP-A: per symbol s in {BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT}, at the first H1 bucket close T >= k_i of an event settlement k_i (E_i = 1): take position -sign(d_i) (short after funding jump-up, long after jump-down), entered at next-bucket VWAP, held until the VWAP of the first H1 bucket whose close >= k_{i+1}; position series in {-1, 0, +1}, one unit notional, one position per symbol, overlapping events ignored.
neighbour: FUNDJUMP-N: same mechanism, different frozen parameters — gate at trailing-90d P75 of |d| (broader) instead of P90; identical direction law, next-settlement holding, fills and costs. Expected ~0.75 events/day/symbol (~2.5x anchor turnover). Probes whether the edge concentrates in extreme jumps or scales with event frequency; must independently satisfy G1-G5 to count as neighbour support (G10).
control: Randomized-event-time sham (event-mechanism control class): with fixed seed 1717, draw per symbol the SAME number of holding windows (matched count, identical next-settlement length, identical fills and once-per-fill tier-2.0 costs, identical force-flat) at H1 closes sampled uniformly over S0, excluding +/-1 day fold purge zones and any close within +/-3 days of a true event boundary (redraw on collision); position sign = -sign(d at the latest settlement <= sham close), redrawing if d = 0. This severs the announcement-event timing link while preserving funding-sign directional content. The convenient explanation it must NOT reproduce: 'shorting positive-funding intervals earns regardless of jumps' (funding-LEVEL carry). Per G11, if the sham earns the same sign with |sham exp| >= 0.5 x |anchor exp|, the family DIES (falsification-by-control).
exposure_series_spec: D2 conditioning exposure for symbol s and H1 bucket with close T: let i(T) = max{i : k_i <= T} from fapi fundingRate history for s; d_i(T) = f_{i(T)} - f_{i(T)-1}; sigma-free event flag E(T) = 1 iff |d_i(T)| >= quantile_{0.90}{|d_j| : k_j <= k_{i(T)}, k_j > k_{i(T)} - 90*86400e3} (undefined -> 0 if fewer than 180 past settlements). exposure_s(T) = -sign(d_i(T)) if E(T)=1 and k_{i(T)} <= T < k_{i(T)+1}, else 0. Availability: only pairs with k_i <= T enter; quantiles past-only. D2 pools exposure_s(T) over s in {BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT} and all S0 H1 buckets and computes pooled rho vs every forbidden conditioning exposure (funding carry 1/3/7d +/-, funding/price divergence, funding-crowding MR, and the full inventory).
falsification_rule: Pre-registered mechanical kills (any one kills the family): (K1) CONTROL REPRODUCES — the randomized-event-time sham earns the same sign as the anchor with |sham exp| >= 0.5 x |anchor exp| at tier 2.0 pooled over S0 (G11) -> DEAD, the funding-level carry explanation wins. (K2) ANCHOR NEGATIVE — anchor after-cost expectancy <= 0 at tier 2.0 in >= 2 of the 3 chronological folds (G1/G3 territory) -> REJECT. (K3) ANCESTRY VETO — D2 pooled |rho| > 0.20 between the exposure series above and ANY forbidden conditioning exposure -> vetoed as re-label; no clock, threshold, symbol-set or sign-flip rescue is permitted.
expected_failure_interpretation: A REJECT means the announced-funding-change event carries no H1-scale exploitable drift after taker tier-2.0 costs: either announcements are pre-impounded (front-run before the settlement boundary), the forced-deleveraging and farmer-supply flows are too small or too slow relative to ~20-24 bps round trips, or the effect is indistinguishable from funding-LEVEL carry ancestry (control reproduces / D2 rho veto). The carry-cost-shock story is falsified as an independent mechanism on this panel and universe; it is dead and not rescuable by re-clocking or re-gating.
expected_failure_mode: COST DOMINATION — the named risk of this sub-daily frontier: per-event drift thinner than the fixed tier-2.0 round trip. Turnover estimate: P90 gate fires on ~10% of settlements -> ~0.3 events/day/symbol x 2 symbols = 0.6 round trips/day = 1.2 taker fills/day = 1.2 fills / 48 H1 decisions/day ~ 0.025 fills per decision. At tier 2.0 (~10 bps fee + 2-tick slip per fill, ~20-24 bps per round trip) the book pays ~14 bps/day drag and needs >= ~24 bps average post-announcement drift per event to clear G1; thinner drift, ignored overlapping events, or force-flat fills at fold edges push expectancy negative — the expected kill is cost, not absence of signal.
